asset_role: visual-only tangent-space live-water normal; no hydraulic, collision, wet-mask, bathymetry, or raft-force authority
generation_method: project-directed generation of an orthographic Zambezi tangent-space normal with multiscale downstream and cross-current structure
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable game texture; tangent-space RGB normal-map data for Unreal water rendering. Primary request: create a square, seamless tangent-space normal map for high-volume sediment-bearing Zambezi River whitewater in Batoka Gorge. Encode irregular flow-aligned surface ridges at mixed real-world scales from roughly 0.25 to 5 meters, with cross-current interference, small eddy dimples, broken chaotic wavelets, and downstream directional structure. Style/medium: production game data texture, not a beauty image; flat-blue tangent-space normal-map appearance, RGB channels encoding surface normals. Composition/framing: orthographic square texture, edge-to-edge, seamless/tileable with mirror addressing; no single focal point. Color palette: tangent-space normal blue/purple/cyan only; dominant neutral flat-normal blue around RGB 128,128,255. Constraints: uniform data-map lighting; continuous usable normal data; no text, no watermark, no logos, no banks, no rocks, no raft, no people, no water color, no foam, no reflected sky, no photographic lighting. Avoid: repeated parallel bands, cellular honeycomb patterns, obvious spirals, concentric rings, isolated icon-like shapes, hard seams, baked shadows, baked highlights.
limitations: The asset is procedural visual infill rather than measured Batoka surface photography.
Mirrored GPU addressing is required because opposite source-image borders are not byte-identical.
It may modulate only solver-owned wet geometry and cannot create hydraulic features.
In-engine visual, guide, water-VFX, and target-hardware acceptance remain required.
